subject: Org access: initial admin plan & invite schedule
messages:
From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Garcia <helen.garcia@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 09:27:00 -0700
Subject: Org access: initial admin plan & invite schedule

Hi Helen,

Thanks again for the quick chat yesterday. Per our discussion, attached is a one-page timeline and a simple ledger template we'll use for the admin invite and API key handoff.

High level plan (first 72 hours after kickoff):
- Day 0: Redwood creates tenant scaffold and initial 'project' namespace. We'll provision a service account and a single API key for early testing.
- Day 1: Seed admin users (your three named admins) and set RBAC roles. Monica will handle key seeding; Ben will validate role entitlements.
- Day 2: KMS integration options and rotation policy review. If you prefer to supply a key in your KMS, we'll walk through binding and a short test.

Please confirm:
1) Technical lead for implementation (email and timezone) — we'll loop them into the kickoff calendar invite.
2) Preferred date for a 45-min kickoff (options: Mon 10 May or Tue 11 May, 10:00-11:00 PT).

Attachments: redwood_onboarding_timeline.pdf (pdf), access_ledger_template.csv (csv)

Next steps after you confirm tech lead/date: we'll send a calendar invite + pre-kickoff checklist.

Best,

Chloe Martin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192

From: Helen Garcia <helen.garcia@astrahealth.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@astrahealth.com>
Date: Wed, 05 May 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org access: initial admin plan & invite schedule

Chloe,

Thanks — this looks good. Samir (cc'd) is our engineering lead and will be the technical contact. He's in PDT as well.

We can do Mon 10 May at 10:00 PT.

A quick question on security: do you have a short doc that describes how API keys are stored and rolled? We'll need that for our InfoSec review before we spin up non-prod keys.

Helen Garcia
Head of Product, AstraHealth
helen.garcia@astrahealth.com

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Garcia <helen.garcia@astrahealth.com>
Cc: Samir Patel <samir.p@astrahealth.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 06 May 2027 08:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Org access: initial admin plan & invite schedule

Helen — thanks, Monday 10 May 10:00 PT is on my calendar. Sending an invite to Samir now.

Short answers for InfoSec: we store API keys encrypted at rest in our secrets store (AES-256-GCM), keys are stored only in the KMS-backed credential store, and we issue short-lived signed tokens for runtime use where feasible. Rotation: default 90-day rotation; customer-managed KMS supported (we can provide an HSM-backed binding checklist). See attached 'kms-integration-note.md' for the binding flow and 'redwood_onboarding_timeline.pdf' for the rollout windows.

Proposed kickoff agenda (45m):
- 5m introductions and goals
- 10m tenant scaffold & RBAC model
- 10m API key seeding and test plan
- 10m KMS options + rotation
- 10m next steps and milestones

Internal owners (for clarity):
- Monica Patel: key seeding and admin invites (ticketing + ledger updates)
- Ben Carter: entitlements verification and end-to-end test
- Jonas Weber: automation of initial namespace provisioning (will monitor)

Attachments: kms-integration-note.md (md), access_ledger_template.csv (csv)

On the ledger: please provide a list of the three admins and their preferred emails; Monica will seed them during the kickoff.

Cheers,
Chloe
